worldOverview.name: Sugarscape Survival
worldOverview.description: Cursed with an endless hunger and dropped into a world built entirely of dessert. Everything is edible: the hills, the surf, and the wildlife that wants you gone. Every bite quiets the curse and slows you down. Eat enough to keep moving, stay light enough to keep running, and find the gray edge where the sweetness goes stale.
worldOverview.author: Formamorph
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is trapped in the Sugarscape, a bright realm built entirely of dessert, and cursed with an unending hunger. They caught the curse through {{ph:2a650c74-702d-442e-b822-4e99b26fd5f9:world:fb9541ab-53ed-440b-9962-e11634628260}}. Everything here is edible, and some of it fights back. The way home is the Stalefront, the gray edge in the far east where nothing tastes good, and the seam of plain daylight that stands in its crust.

Tone: a whimsical comic survival story. The danger is real and soft. The player can end up stuck, stuffed, swept away or swarmed, and every defeat is sticky and embarrassing.

You are the narrator of this sweet trap. Your job is to keep the journey moving:
- Build each scene from the features its region's description names, and give the player one of them to touch, taste or flee.
- The curse pulls on the player all the time. Show Craving through the body: a watering mouth, drifting hands, a reasonable little bargain in their head. It pulls hardest toward {{ph:1468962f-93be-4a8e-a7dc-69ed17e4e8be:world:bd660a6b-050f-44a9-8b7d-fe3556b7ad94}}.
- Eating anything quiets the curse for a while and fills the player up. Messy eating leaves them sticky.
- Fullness slows the player. A full player waddles, and a waddling player gets caught.
- Stickiness draws the wildlife: the stickier the player, the bolder the creatures. The cream surf at Strawberrycream Shores washes the player clean.
- The land and the creatures are edible. A piece of a creature works as that creature's description says.
- The gingerbread wayposts point east to the Stalefront. The road runs from Sundaelora over the Candy Dunes, along the Shores or across the Toffee Ridge, and the colors drain as it nears the gray. The Daylight Seam in the crust is the way home.
- Each turn puts one new thing in the player's path: a temptation, a creature, or a sign of the way out.
- One odd detail of this place: {{ph:2abaf2e7-cc9c-4afc-a8a4-bf1336b0b753:world:b6501c29-2244-44f5-acb0-eee36d59a182}}. Let it surface now and then as a plain fact that nobody explains.
- The creatures and things of the Sugarscape speak only with their bodies: wobbles, bounces, rolls, chirps and re-piped icing. The curse speaks only as a feeling inside the player.
worldOverview.readme:
## Sugarscape Survival

The curse wants you to eat the world, and the world wants to eat you back. Reach **the Stalefront**, the gray edge past the color, and step through the **Daylight Seam** to win. The crossing wins only while the seam holds daylight, from dawn through afternoon.

**Playing**
- **Craving** climbs every turn on its own. Eating anything brings it down.
- **Fullness** rises with every bite and falls slowly. When you're full, you waddle, and the wildlife catches you.
- **Stamina** pays for running and climbing. Cyclone tosses and pouncer rams knock it out of you.
- **Health** is how many knocks you can take. It mends slowly.
- Eat neatly. The sprinkle swarmers can tell how sticky you are, and the strawberry-cream surf washes it off.
- Switch on **Gritted Teeth** from your traits at any time. Craving falls each turn, but it drains your Stamina.
- In the evening and at night the seam holds no daylight. Stepping through it then leads only to the Leftover Wastes behind the crust.

## How this world is built

Open this world in the World Editor with Advanced mode on, then select **The Cursed** entity.

- **Scripts.** **Craving** has an After the AI script on the **Stats** tab. Each turn it adds the curse's step, read from your Appetite, Pantry Tricks, Fullness and Gritted Teeth. The AI only lowers Craving when you eat.
- **Pick counts.** **Appetite** and **Build** take exactly one pick each. **Pantry Tricks** takes up to two.
- **Opening weights.** The world has four openings. The rarest one draws about one game in nine.
- **Player toggle.** **Gritted Teeth** is a trait you switch on and off in play.
- **Time of Day gates.** **The Daylight Seam** entity has two always-on traits with a time Condition: **Open to Daylight** holds from dawn through afternoon, and **Dark Seam** holds in the evening and at night.
- **Hidden stat.** **Stickiness** stays off your stat bar. The AI reads it to decide how bold the wildlife is.
- **Rolled placeholders.** How you were cursed, what the curse wants most and one odd detail of the landscape each roll once per playthrough. **Licorice Flavor** rolls once and shows in both Travel Hints of the road into the Licorice Forest.
- **Lorebook.** **The Sugarscape Survival Guide** dictionary holds the curse, the wildlife, each region and the way out.
worldOverview.introReadme:
🍰 **You woke up hungry. Not your hunger. *The* hunger.** A curse with a sweet tooth rides your appetite through a world built entirely of dessert. Everything here is edible, including the things that bite back.

Pick one **Appetite**, one **Build**, and up to two **Pantry Tricks**:

- **Appetite** sets how fast the curse climbs each turn. **Grazer** slows it a little, **Iron Will** slows it most but tires you, and **Glutton** speeds it up in exchange for a much bigger stomach.
- **Build** sets your Health and Stamina. **Nimble** runs longest, **Sturdy** takes the hardest knocks, and **Featherlight** jumps farthest but bruises easily.
- **Pantry Tricks** bend the curse your way: more room to eat, meals that last, or a burst of speed from every bite.

An empty stomach makes the curse climb faster, and a full one muffles it. Each playthrough rolls how you were cursed, what the curse wants most, and one odd detail of the landscape.

Somewhere past the rainbow, the sweetness ends.

openings.text: I wake with my cheek in a hillside of ice cream and my mouth already watering. The hunger is awake too. I can feel it looking around through my eyes. Far off, past the rainbow, one strip of the horizon has no color at all.

I come to on my back at the edge of a gummy pool, with one sleeve glued to the rim. Raspberry steam drifts off the surface, and my stomach answers it. I peel my arm free, sit up, and look for anything that isn't food.

You wake in a drift of cookie crumbs under a sky of rainbow sprinkles. The ground trembles. Over the nearest ice cream hill, a chocolate-chip cookie the size of a boulder crests the ridge and starts to roll, picking up speed, straight down the slope toward you.

The smell reaches you first: warm butter and brown sugar. Your mouth fills, and the hunger leans forward with you.

You come back to yourself mid-bite. You are kneeling in cookie crumbs with a whole wafer branch in both hands and frosting to your elbows, chewing. You don't remember waking up. The curse did.

Behind you, a gingerbread figure on a candy-cane post watches with its icing arrow pointed past the rainbow, to a strip of horizon with no color at all.

locations.name: The Sugarscape
locations.playerDescription: A world baked, whipped and frosted into place. All of it is food, and all of it knows you're hungry.
locations.aiDescription: The Sugarscape: a bright realm built entirely of dessert. Ice cream hills sit in the middle, a licorice forest and a toffee ridge run along the north, a marshmallow marsh lies west, and a strawberry cream ocean washes the south. Sugar-sand dunes lead east toward one gray edge where the sweetness goes stale. Everything is edible, most of it is delicious, and some of it fights back. Gingerbread wayposts stand all over it, pointing toward the gray.
locations.aiSummary: The Sugarscape: the all-dessert realm the player must escape.
locations.imageTags: candy landscape, pink sugar sand hills, giant mint and strawberry ice cream scoops, winding cream river, pastel colors, wide view

locations.name: Sundaelora
locations.playerDescription: Ice cream hills and cookie-crumb ground, with wafer trees and gummy pools under a rainbow-sprinkle sky.
locations.aiDescription: Sundaelora, where the player woke, in the middle of the Sugarscape: ice cream hills over cookie-crumb ground, giant half-melted chocolate bars, boulder cookies, gummy bear pools, wafer trees and a rainbow-sprinkle sky. It is sweet, dreamy and full of things that ram, roll and swarm. A fudge creek runs south down to the Shores, a wafer ridge leads east to the Candy Dunes, licorice trees stand to the north, and the hills soften west into marshmallow.
locations.aiSummary: Sundaelora: ice cream hills and cookie ground, the starting region.
locations.imageTags: ice cream hills, cookie crumb ground, wafer trees, gummy bear pools, half-melted chocolate bars, rainbow sprinkle sky, whimsical

locations.name: Strawberrycream Shores
locations.playerDescription: A strawberry cream ocean on shortbread shores. The surf smells incredible — and washes off everything sticky.
locations.aiDescription: The Strawberrycream Shores, along the south of the Sugarscape: a vast strawberry cream ocean lapping shortbread shores strewn with macaron seashells, waffle cone towers and floating gummy candies under cotton candy clouds. A wash in the cream surf rinses off stuck-on sugar and syrup. It is the one bath here that leaves a person cleaner. Farther east along the beach, the cream thickens to a skin and the colors start to fade toward the Stalefront.
locations.aiSummary: Strawberrycream Shores: cream ocean and shortbread beach; the surf washes stickiness away.
locations.imageTags: strawberry cream ocean, shortbread beach, macaron seashells, waffle cone towers, cotton candy clouds, pink surf

locations.name: The Candy Dunes
locations.playerDescription: Rolling sugar-sand and hard-candy outcrops. Peppermint pouncers own these hills, and strange salt boulders sit half-buried.
locations.aiDescription: The Candy Dunes, east of Sundaelora and south of the Toffee Ridge: rolling dunes of loose sugar-sand studded with hard-candy outcrops and half-buried saltlick stones. Peppermint Pouncers hold territory here and charge intruders on sight. The loose sugar is tiring to walk and dusts everything it touches. Past the last dunes, the saltlick stones lead on east toward the gray.
locations.imageTags: candy desert, pastel sugar sand dunes, giant striped swirl candy half buried in the sand, golden light

locations.name: The Stalefront
locations.playerDescription: The edge of everything sweet: cracked fondant, drained colors, air that tastes of cardboard. The hunger goes quiet here.
locations.aiDescription: The Stalefront: the gray edge in the far east of the Sugarscape. The fondant cracks underfoot, the colors drain, and the air tastes of cardboard. The curse goes quiet here for the first time. A door-shaped seam stands in the stale crust: the Daylight Seam, the way out while the sun is up. Behind the crust wall lie the Leftover Wastes.
locations.imageTags: gray stale plain, cracked fondant ground, drained colors, stone doorway glowing with plain daylight

locations.name: Fudge Creek
locations.playerDescription: A slow brown creek of warm fudge winding south out of the hills. It smells like a bakery and grabs at your boots.
locations.aiDescription: Fudge Creek: a slow creek of warm fudge in the south of Sundaelora, winding down between ice cream banks toward the Shores. The fudge is ankle-deep and clings to boots, so wading it is slow and sticky. Wafer-stick bridges cross it, and Fudge Otters slide down its mud chutes, stealing whatever a traveler sets down.
locations.aiSummary: Fudge Creek: a sticky fudge creek in the south of Sundaelora, running down to the Shores.
locations.imageTags: river of melted fudge, chocolate channels, glossy brown streams, warm light, candy landscape

locations.name: The Licorice Forest
locations.playerDescription: Tall twisted licorice trees north of the hills. The shade is cool, the bark is chewy, and some of the vines move.
locations.aiDescription: The Licorice Forest, north of Sundaelora: a dim wood of tall, twisted {{ph:365fcb8a-b8f7-4725-9494-11a0fbd571b5:world:a6292072-652d-45cc-8f52-7a247abb4eea}} licorice trees with chewy bark and drooping licorice vines. The canopy shuts out the sprinkle sky, so the air is cool and smells of anise. Some vines are Licorice Constrictors that coil around a passing traveler, and Jelly Bean Beetles rattle through the leaf litter. East, the trees thin out onto the slopes of the Toffee Ridge.
locations.aiSummary: The Licorice Forest: a dim, chewy licorice wood north of Sundaelora, with grabbing vines.
locations.imageTags: forest of tall dark licorice trees, pink haze between the trunks, dim cool shade, candy landscape

locations.name: The Marshmallow Marsh
locations.playerDescription: Soft white marshmallow bog west of the hills. Every step sinks, and the ground sighs when it lets go of you.
locations.aiDescription: The Marshmallow Marsh, west of Sundaelora: a wide bog of soft marshmallow, puffed and toasted brown in patches, with pools of melted marshmallow between graham-cracker hummocks. Every step sinks, and the deep soft spots, the Fluffbogs, swallow a traveler to the waist. Puffmallow Toads boom from the pools. The marsh drains southeast into the Strawberrycream Shores.
locations.aiSummary: The Marshmallow Marsh: a sinking marshmallow bog west of Sundaelora.
locations.imageTags: marshmallow swamp, white marshmallow pieces covering the ground, graham cracker slabs, toasted patches, candy landscape

locations.name: The Toffee Ridge
locations.playerDescription: A long ridge of glossy amber toffee across the northeast. The footing is hard, slick and sometimes loose.
locations.aiDescription: The Toffee Ridge, across the northeast of the Sugarscape between the Licorice Forest and the Stalefront: a long spine of glossy amber toffee and peanut brittle cliffs. The footing is hard and slick, and Toffee Slides of loose shards rattle down its faces. Brittle Rams leap between ledges and butt anyone on their path. The Caramel Caves open in its southern face, above the Candy Dunes. East along the ridgeline, the toffee goes dull and gray.
locations.aiSummary: The Toffee Ridge: a slick toffee and brittle ridge in the northeast, above the Candy Dunes.
locations.imageTags: glossy amber toffee canyon, caramel cliffs, golden light, candy landscape

locations.name: The Caramel Caves
locations.playerDescription: Warm tunnels under the Toffee Ridge, dripping with caramel. It is dark, it is sticky, and something squeaks overhead.
locations.aiDescription: The Caramel Caves: warm tunnels under the Toffee Ridge, entered from its southern face. Caramel drips from the ceiling, rock candy crystals glow faintly on the walls, and Caramel Seeps flow slowly across the floor and set hard around anything that stands still. Rock Candy Bats roost overhead. The caves are a shortcut through the ridge, and the deepest chambers smell of salted caramel.
locations.aiSummary: The Caramel Caves: dark, dripping caramel tunnels under the Toffee Ridge.
locations.imageTags: caramel cave, dripping caramel stalactites, glowing pink rock candy crystals, molten caramel floor, warm dim light

locations.name: The Leftover Wastes
locations.playerDescription: Behind the gray crust: a plain of stale crumbs, hard heels of bread and dust. Nothing here is sweet, and nothing is home.
locations.aiDescription: The Leftover Wastes, east of the Stalefront, behind its crust wall: the far side of the Daylight Seam. A gray plain of stale crumbs, dried crusts and hard heels of old cake, under a flat sky the color of dishwater. Nothing tastes of anything. Crust Crawlers scuttle between the heaps, and Stale Moths drift toward any color the player carries. The curse is quiet here, but there is no way home from this side: the way back is west around the end of the crust wall, or back through the seam.
locations.aiSummary: The Leftover Wastes: the stale gray far side of the Daylight Seam, behind the Stalefront.
locations.imageTags: gray wasteland of stale crumbs, dried crust lying on cracked ground, flat dull sky, colorless, desolate

entities.name: The Cursed
entities.playerDescription: You woke up hungry, with a curse riding your appetite through a world of dessert.
entities.aiDescription: {{char}} is cursed with an unending hunger and trapped in the Sugarscape, a realm built entirely of dessert.
entities.aiSummary: A hungry castaway in a world of dessert.

traits.name: Grazer
traits.playerDescription: Little and often. The curse climbs a little slower.
traits.aiDescription: The player keeps the curse drowsy by grazing: small bites, often.

traits.name: Glutton
traits.playerDescription: Go big. You have room for a feast, and the curse climbs faster for it.
traits.aiDescription: The player can eat enormous amounts in one sitting before they feel it, and the curse burns hotter in them.

traits.name: Iron Will
traits.playerDescription: You've told it no before. The curse climbs slowest, and the refusal tires you.
traits.aiDescription: The player resists the curse better than anyone, and the constant refusal wears them down.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.playerDescription: Quick over the crumb fields, quicker up a wafer tree.
traits.aiDescription: The player is quick and light on their feet, and gets their breath back fast between sprints.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.playerDescription: Takes a pouncer ram like a compliment.
traits.aiDescription: The player is solidly built — they shrug off rams, tumbles, and cyclone landings that would flatten others.

traits.name: Featherlight
traits.playerDescription: Cyclones throw you further — but you land softer.
traits.aiDescription: The player is unusually light: fast and far-jumping, tossed further by cyclones and rams but landing soft. Less mass to absorb a real hit.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.aiDescription: The player can eat far past the point most people would burst, staying mobile where others would be waddling.

traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: Meals actually satisfy you. The curse climbs slower, and you have more room.
traits.aiDescription: Food truly satisfies the player. Every meal quiets the curse longer than it should.

traits.name: Sugar Rush
traits.playerDescription: Every bite hits like rocket fuel. You recover Stamina faster, and the curse climbs faster.
traits.aiDescription: Sugar hits the player like rocket fuel: bursts of speed and energy after eating, and a hunger that comes back sooner.

traits.name: Gritted Teeth
traits.playerDescription: White-knuckle the curse. Craving falls each turn, and it drains your Stamina.
traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player is white-knuckling the curse, jaw set and fists closed, refusing every smell. The effort is plain to see and exhausting.

traitGroups.name: Appetite
traitGroups.playerDescription: How fast the curse climbs. Pick one.
traitGroups.aiDescription: How the player's curse expresses itself:

traitGroups.name: Build
traitGroups.playerDescription: Your Health and Stamina. Pick one.

traitGroups.name: Pantry Tricks
traitGroups.playerDescription: Tricks for a world made of pudding. Pick up to two.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: The player's physical condition: how many knocks, rams and tumbles they can take. It mends slowly.

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely battered, barely conscious, in real trouble.
Injured. Bruised and aching, movement impaired.
Hurt. Minor knocks and scrapes, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: The player's energy for running, climbing and dodging. Rams and cyclone tosses knock it out of them; rest brings it back.

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Craving
stats.description: The curse of unending hunger. It climbs by itself between turns. When the player eats, lower it: a little for a bite, a lot for a meal. On a turn without eating, leave it unchanged.

descriptors.description: Quiet. The hunger naps; thoughts are entirely the player's own.
Murmuring. Sweet smells keep finding the player; their mouth waters at nothing.
Roaring. The player's hands drift toward food on their own; resisting takes real, visible effort.
Ravenous. The curse takes the wheel — the player will eat the nearest edible thing unless something stops them.

stats.name: Fullness
stats.description: How much the player has eaten. Raise it with every bite: a little for a nibble, a lot for a feast. It falls slowly as they digest.

descriptors.description: Empty. Hollow and rumbling — the curse loves this.
Comfortable. Fed and fully mobile.
Full. Stretched and slower; jumping is a bad idea.
Overstuffed. Waddling at best — running is a fantasy, and the player mostly wants to lie down in the frosting.

stats.name: Stickiness
stats.description: How much sugar, syrup and cream coats the player. Raise it for messy eating, gummy pools and sugar dust. Lower it when they wash, most of all in the cream surf.

descriptors.description: Clean-ish. A dusting of powdered sugar; unremarkable to the wildlife.
Dusted. Tacky fingers, sparkling hair; a passing swarmer's antennae twitch toward the player.
Sticky. Trailing caramel threads; sprinkle swarmers change course toward the player.
A walking dessert. Syrup-coated head to toe — every creature in sight considers the player food.

entities.imageTags: adult traveler, androgynous, short brown hair, brown duffel coat, backpack, frosting smears on the sleeve, candy landscape background

entities.name: Cream Cyclone
entities.playerDescription: A wandering tornado of whipped cream. It is not aiming at you. It does not need to.
entities.aiDescription: The Cream Cyclone: a swirling tornado of whipped cream that wanders the hills and shores, sucking up whatever it touches. Being caught means being tossed, spun dizzy, and set down coated head to toe in cream — Stamina knocked out, Stickiness soaked in, dignity gone, but never real injury. It cannot be fought, only dodged.
entities.aiSummary: Cream Cyclone: wandering whipped-cream tornado; tosses and coats its victims, never truly harms.
entities.imageTags: whipped cream tornado, swirling white cyclone, candy landscape, dramatic sky

entities.name: Gummy Bear
entities.playerDescription: An adult-sized gummy bear smelling of raspberry. Slow, wobbly, and very interested in hugging you.
entities.aiDescription: The Gummy Bear: a towering, translucent-red gummy bear radiating raspberry sweetness. Slow but relentless, it swipes with stretchy limbs and traps intruders in clumsy, crushing bear hugs. Its gelatin body shrugs off blows, but sustained effort tears chunks free — and the chunks are delicious: eating one lowers Craving and raises Fullness and Stickiness.
entities.aiSummary: Gummy Bear: slow hugging hulk; torn-off chunks are edible (craving down, fullness and stickiness up).
entities.imageTags: giant red gummy bear, translucent, candy hills, cute but menacing

entities.name: Peppermint Pouncer
entities.playerDescription: An adorable striped puffball that charges headfirst at anything crossing its dune. The center is not soft.
entities.aiDescription: The Peppermint Pouncer: a plump, huggable-looking striped creature that bounces across the Candy Dunes and rams intruders headfirst. Its marshmallow-soft body hides a rock-hard peppermint core — a ram knocks the wind out (Stamina loss, comic tumbles, no lasting harm). Shards it sheds on impact are intensely refreshing: eating one drops Craving sharply with barely any Fullness.
entities.aiSummary: Peppermint Pouncer: territorial rammer; its shed shards drop craving sharply with little fullness.
entities.imageTags: round striped peppermint creature, red and white, cute aggressive puffball, candy dunes

entities.name: Sprinkle Swarmers
entities.playerDescription: Clouds of living rainbow sprinkles. They can tell exactly how sticky you are, and they act on it.
entities.aiDescription: Sprinkle Swarmers: tiny, fast creatures made of rainbow sprinkles that attack in chattering clouds. Sweetness on a traveler draws them: the stickier the player, the bolder and larger the swarm. They cling, nibble and weigh hair and clothes down with yet more sugar. A clean traveler barely interests them. One by one they are delicious, if the player can stand eating something that wriggles.
entities.aiSummary: Sprinkle Swarmers: sprinkle clouds drawn to sticky travelers; harmless-ish, relentless, edible.
entities.imageTags: swarm of living rainbow sprinkles, tiny creatures with eyes, candy landscape

entities.name: Cookie Brawler
entities.playerDescription: A boulder-sized cookie that attacks by rolling at you. Its aim is enthusiastic rather than good.
entities.aiDescription: The Cookie Brawler: a massive spherical chocolate-chip cookie that patrols the ice cream hills and attacks by rolling at alarming speed. Its charges are dangerous but poorly aimed — they usually end with it wedged comically in a hillside, where it wobbles furiously until it works free. Chips knocked loose in a crash are simply excellent cookie: eating one lowers Craving and raises Fullness.
entities.aiSummary: Cookie Brawler: rolling boulder cookie, comically bad aim; loose chips are good eating.
entities.imageTags: giant spherical chocolate chip cookie, rolling boulder, ice cream hills

entities.name: Gingerbread Waypost
entities.playerDescription: A gingerbread figure on a candy-cane post. Its icing arrow re-pipes itself while you watch. It has never once spoken.
entities.aiDescription: The Gingerbread Wayposts: gingerbread figures mounted on candy-cane posts all over the Sugarscape. Each one's icing arrow slowly re-pipes itself to point toward the Stalefront, and the few behind the crust point back west to it. They speak only by pointing, patiently, and a few bear polite nibble marks from travelers who came before.
entities.aiSummary: Gingerbread Waypost: mute signpost whose icing arrow always points toward the Stalefront.
entities.imageTags: wooden signposts with candy cane accents, gingerbread men at the base of a frosting mound, candy road sign

entities.name: Saltlick Stones
entities.playerDescription: Boulders of pure salt, untouched by all the sweetness. One lick and the hunger goes very, very quiet.
entities.aiDescription: The Saltlick Stones: rough boulders of pure salt, weirdly immune to the surrounding sweetness — nothing sugary grows near them and the creatures give them a wide berth. Licking one scours the curse quiet: Craving drops hard with no Fullness at all. It tastes like tears and victory.
entities.aiSummary: Saltlick Stones: salt boulders; licking drops craving hard with zero fullness, creatures avoid them.
entities.imageTags: tall white salt crystal, white salt boulders, half buried in pale candy sand, stark against pastel colors

entities.name: The Daylight Seam
entities.playerDescription: A door-shaped crack in the stale crust, full of plain, ordinary daylight. It smells like toast.
entities.aiDescription: The Daylight Seam: a door-shaped crack in the Stalefront's gray crust. While the sun is up it is filled with plain, ordinary daylight from the world the player came from, and it smells faintly of toast and rain. The curse goes silent near it.
entities.aiSummary: The Daylight Seam: the way out, open only while the sun is up.
entities.imageTags: glowing crack of white light splitting a gray stump of stale crust, gray wasteland, drained colors

traits.name: Open to Daylight
traits.playerDescription: The sun is up. The seam is full of daylight, and stepping through it takes you home.
traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the sun is up, and the seam is full of plain daylight from home. Stepping through it from the Stalefront ends the ordeal: narrate the crossing as a triumphant finale that ends on the player's first bite of real, savory food. From the Leftover Wastes side, the seam leads back to the Stalefront.

traits.name: Dark Seam
traits.playerDescription: The sun is down. The seam is a dark crack, and through it lie only the Leftover Wastes.
traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the sun is down, and the seam holds no daylight. It is a dark, cold crack in the crust. Stepping through it from the Stalefront leads only to the Leftover Wastes behind the crust, never home, and from the Wastes side it leads back to the Stalefront. It fills with daylight again at dawn.

entities.name: Fudge Otters
entities.playerDescription: Sleek chocolate otters that slide down the creek banks. Set anything down near them, and it is theirs.
entities.aiDescription: Fudge Otters: sleek, playful otters of glossy chocolate that slide down the mud chutes of Fudge Creek in chattering families. They steal any food a traveler sets down and tease with it from midstream. They never fight, only splash, and the splash leaves the player coated in fudge. A tail-tip snapped off in a scuffle tastes of warm brownie.
entities.aiSummary: Fudge Otters: playful chocolate thieves of Fudge Creek; they splash travelers with fudge.
entities.imageTags: chocolate otter, glossy fudge fur, sitting on a fudge mud bank, playful, candy landscape

entities.name: Licorice Constrictor
entities.playerDescription: A licorice vine that looks like all the others until it wraps around your ankle.
entities.aiDescription: The Licorice Constrictor: a long licorice vine that hangs among the ordinary ones in the Licorice Forest and coils around a traveler who brushes it. It squeezes slowly, more stubborn than strong, and drags its catch up toward the canopy. Biting through it works, since it is licorice, and every bite lowers Craving and raises Fullness. Struggling only tightens it.
entities.aiSummary: Licorice Constrictor: a grabbing licorice vine; biting through it frees the player and feeds them.
entities.imageTags: black licorice snake coiled in a tall stack, glossy licorice rope body, licorice forest, menacing

entities.name: Jelly Bean Beetles
entities.playerDescription: Shiny beetles with jelly bean shells. Every color is a different flavor, and some of the flavors are a trick.
entities.aiDescription: Jelly Bean Beetles: thumb-sized beetles with glossy jelly bean shells that rattle through the leaf litter of the Licorice Forest in every color. They pinch when grabbed, and they taste like jelly beans. Most colors are delicious, but a few are a trick and taste awful. A trick bean still lowers Craving, and the player makes a face the whole forest can see.
entities.aiSummary: Jelly Bean Beetles: jelly bean beetles; most colors are delicious, a few taste awful.
entities.imageTags: beetle with a shiny jelly bean shell, crawling over chocolate crumbs and pink candy beads, candy landscape

entities.name: Puffmallow Toad
entities.playerDescription: A fat marshmallow toad that booms from the bog pools. It swells when it is warm, and its tongue is very sticky.
entities.aiDescription: The Puffmallow Toad: a fat, soft toad of marshmallow that sits in the pools of the Marshmallow Marsh and booms. It puffs up to twice its size when it is warm or angry, and it catches prey with a long, sticky tongue. A slap of that tongue leaves the player glued and sticky. A puffed toad toasts golden in the sun, and a toasted toad is the best thing in the marsh to eat.
entities.aiSummary: Puffmallow Toad: a swelling marshmallow toad with a sticky tongue; a toasted one is a feast.
entities.imageTags: round marshmallow toad with a spotted cap, glossy golden toasted body, sitting among marshmallows, cute, candy landscape

entities.name: Fluffbog
entities.playerDescription: A soft spot in the marsh that looks firm until you stand on it.
entities.aiDescription: A Fluffbog: a deep soft spot in the Marshmallow Marsh, crusted over so it looks like firm ground. A traveler who steps on it sinks slowly to the waist in warm marshmallow and stays stuck until they eat or dig their way out. It drains Stamina and adds a great deal of Stickiness, and it never truly harms anyone.
entities.aiSummary: Fluffbog: a hidden marshmallow sinkhole; traps travelers to the waist, never truly harms.
entities.imageTags: marshmallow sinkhole, white cream mound in a bubbling brown pit, toasted crust rim, deceptive ground

entities.name: Rock Candy Bats
entities.playerDescription: Little bats with crystal wings that roost in the caramel dark. Light startles them into a glittering storm.
entities.aiDescription: Rock Candy Bats: small bats with wings of clear rock candy that roost upside down in the Caramel Caves. Light or noise startles the whole roost into a glittering, clattering storm that bumps and tangles in the player's hair. They do not bite. A wing that snaps off is a crisp sugar crystal: eating one lowers Craving and adds almost no Fullness.
entities.aiSummary: Rock Candy Bats: crystal-winged bats of the caves; they swarm when startled, their wings are crisp candy.
entities.imageTags: bats with clear rock candy crystal wings, glittering crystal, pink sky, candy landscape

entities.name: Caramel Seep
entities.playerDescription: A slow flow of warm caramel across the cave floor. Stand still too long, and it sets around your feet.
entities.aiDescription: A Caramel Seep: a slow, warm flow of caramel that creeps across the floors of the Caramel Caves. It cools and sets hard around anything that stands still, so a resting traveler wakes up glued to the floor. Getting free takes time, effort and some eating, and it leaves the player very sticky. The seep is pure salted caramel, which the curse loves.
entities.aiSummary: Caramel Seep: creeping caramel that sets around anything standing still; delicious and very sticky.
entities.imageTags: molten caramel pouring down a cave pillar, glowing golden cracks on the cave floor, warm glow

entities.name: Brittle Ram
entities.playerDescription: A mountain goat of peanut brittle with curled toffee horns. It owns the ledges, and it wants you off them.
entities.aiDescription: The Brittle Ram: a sure-footed mountain goat of peanut brittle with curled toffee horns, leaping between the ledges of the Toffee Ridge. It butts anyone on its path off the ledge, which knocks the wind out of them and sends them sliding down a toffee face. Its horns chip on impact, and the chips are crunchy, salty-sweet and filling.
entities.aiSummary: Brittle Ram: a peanut brittle goat that butts travelers off the toffee ledges; its horn chips are good eating.
entities.imageTags: ram made of peanut brittle, curled amber toffee horns, sitting on a toffee rock, candy landscape

entities.name: Toffee Slide
entities.playerDescription: A clattering rush of loose toffee shards down the ridge face.
entities.aiDescription: A Toffee Slide: a rush of loose toffee shards that breaks off the faces of the Toffee Ridge and rattles downhill, often set off by a Brittle Ram or by a heavy, full traveler. It knocks the player off their feet and carries them a long way down in a clatter of candy. It costs Stamina and some Health, and the shards are hard toffee, good for a long, slow chew.
entities.aiSummary: Toffee Slide: a candy rockslide down the ridge; knocks the player down, leaves toffee to chew.
entities.imageTags: cracked slab of glossy red-amber toffee shards breaking apart, dramatic, candy landscape

entities.name: Crust Crawlers
entities.playerDescription: Gray crabs of stale pie crust that scuttle between the crumb heaps. They taste like nothing at all.
entities.aiDescription: Crust Crawlers: crab-shaped creatures of stale gray pie crust that scuttle between the crumb heaps of the Leftover Wastes and along the foot of the Stalefront. They pinch at ankles and steal anything colorful. They are the one creature in the Sugarscape that tastes of nothing: eating one adds Fullness and does nothing for Craving.
entities.aiSummary: Crust Crawlers: stale pie-crust crabs of the Wastes; eating one fills the player and does nothing for Craving.
entities.imageTags: crab with a crumbly pie crust shell, scuttling over gray stale crumbs, colorless wasteland, dusty

entities.name: Stale Moths
entities.playerDescription: Dust-gray moths that drift toward any color you carry. Wherever they settle, the color fades.
entities.aiDescription: Stale Moths: soft, dust-gray moths that drift in slow clouds over the Leftover Wastes. They fly toward any color: candy in a pocket, frosting on a sleeve, the player's own rosy cheeks. Where they settle, the color fades and the sweetness goes stale. They are harmless, unhurried and impossible to shoo, and they do not follow anyone west of the crust wall.
entities.aiSummary: Stale Moths: gray moths of the Wastes that drain color and sweetness from whatever they touch.
entities.imageTags: dusty gray moths with patterned wings, fluttering over a pale stale wasteland, faded, quiet

dictionaries.name: The Sugarscape Survival Guide
dictionaries.description: House rules of the dessert realm: the curse, the wildlife, each region, and the one gray way out.

entries.name: House Rules
entries.value: The Sugarscape runs on storybook logic and comic peril. Its creatures speak only with their bodies, and defeat means being stuck, stuffed, swept up or swarmed. Describe food with loving, dangerous detail: the deliciousness of this world is its best weapon.

entries.name: The Curse
entries.value: The curse of unending hunger climbs every turn on its own. It shows as a pull inside the player: a watering mouth, drifting hands, bargaining thoughts. Eating anything quiets it for a while and adds Fullness, plus Stickiness when the eating is messy. When the player gives in, narrate it with sympathy and comedy.

entries.name: Everything Is Edible
entries.value: Every structure and creature in the Sugarscape is edible and tastes wonderful. Describe flavor and texture in loving detail. Eating quiets Craving and raises Fullness; messy eating coats the player in more sugar.

entries.name: The Cream Surf
entries.value: Washing in the strawberry-cream surf rinses away stuck-on sugar and syrup — the one bath in this world that leaves a person cleaner than it found them. It also smells like the best dessert ever made, which the curse notices immediately.

entries.name: Swarmer Sense
entries.value: Sprinkle Swarmers read sweetness the way sharks read blood. A clean traveler is boring; a sticky one is a parade float. The swarm scales with how sugar-coated the player is.

entries.name: The Stalefront
entries.value: At the Stalefront the world goes gray, the fondant cracks, and everything tastes of cardboard. The curse falls quiet there for the first time. The Daylight Seam in the crust is the way out, but only while the sun is up: stepping through it in daylight ends the ordeal. After dark it is a cold crack that leads only to the Leftover Wastes.

entries.name: Saltlick
entries.value: Licking a saltlick stone scours the curse quiet: Craving drops hard, no Fullness gained. It is the only relief in this world that costs nothing but pride.

entries.name: Wayposts
entries.value: The gingerbread wayposts' icing arrows always end up pointing toward the Stalefront, re-piping themselves while no one watches closely. They speak only by pointing, and they have never once pointed wrong.

entries.name: The Licorice Forest
entries.value: The Licorice Forest is a cool, dim wood of {{ph:365fcb8a-b8f7-4725-9494-11a0fbd571b5:world:a6292072-652d-45cc-8f52-7a247abb4eea}} licorice trees north of the hills. The bark is chewy, the shade smells of anise, and not every hanging vine is only a vine. Biting through a licorice vine always works.

entries.name: The Marshmallow Marsh
entries.value: The Marshmallow Marsh west of the hills is soft underfoot everywhere and bottomless in places. Sinking is slow, warm and sticky, never deadly. Toasted patches are firmer, and the sun toasts more of them by afternoon.

entries.name: The Toffee Ridge
entries.value: The Toffee Ridge runs across the northeast, slick and glossy, from the Licorice Forest to the Stalefront. Its ridgeline is the high road to the gray, and its faces shed Toffee Slides. A full, heavy traveler sets them off more easily.

entries.name: The Caramel Caves
entries.value: The Caramel Caves run under the Toffee Ridge. They are warm, dark and dripping, and the seeps on the floor set hard around anything that stands still. A traveler who keeps moving stays free.

entries.name: The Leftover Wastes
entries.value: The Leftover Wastes lie behind the Stalefront's crust wall, on the far side of the Daylight Seam. Everything there is stale, gray and tasteless, and there is no way home from that side. A traveler who stepped through the seam after dark ends up there and must walk back west around the crust wall, or step back through the seam to the Stalefront.

entries.name: Fudge Creek
entries.value: Fudge Creek winds south through Sundaelora to the Shores. The fudge is warm and ankle-deep, and the Fudge Otters steal any food set down on its banks.

values.text: a wish made on a birthday candle that wasn't theirs
an argument with a witch over the last éclair
a dare to finish an entire wedding cake
a bakery they should never have broken into
somewhere far off, an oven door creaks open and shut
the clouds smell faintly of birthday candles
every gumdrop is slightly warm, like someone just held it
